facts.text: The hotel is set along Playa Veneros in Riviera Nayarit.
facts.excerpt: W Punta de Mita is set along Playa Veneros

facts.text: Guests can walk down from their rooms to fast-breaking beach waves with left and right rides.
facts.excerpt: Walk down from your room to our fast-breaking beach waves, with left and right rides

facts.text: A certified surf vendor offers private and group lessons by advance booking.
facts.excerpt: Our certified surf vendor offers private and group lessons, available by advance booking.

facts.text: The hotel is 20 minutes from Sayulita and 10 minutes from Marina La Cruz.
facts.excerpt: Just 20 minutes from Sayulita and 10 minutes from Marina La Cruz

facts.text: The design blends colonial grandeur with the artistry of the indigenous Huichol peoples.
facts.excerpt: Colonial grandeur blends seamlessly with the extraordinary artistry of the indigenous Huichol peoples.

facts.text: The WET outdoor pool overlooks the beach and is reached from the Living Room via the blue and green mosaic Camino Huichol walkway.
facts.excerpt: Our shimmering outdoor pool overlooks the beach and is accessible from the Living Room via the bright blue and green mosaic “Camino Huichol” walkway.

facts.text: WET Too is an adults-only area with unobstructed views of the Pacific Ocean.
facts.excerpt: Revel at WET Too, an adults-only playground with unobstructed views of the Pacific Ocean.

facts.text: Rooms have bohemian surf touches and Mexican accents, including woven screens, surfboards and murals.
facts.excerpt: Infused with bohemian surf vibes, each offers unmistakably Mexican accents, including playful pillows, woven screens, surfboards, and imaginative murals

facts.text: Rooms and suites have private balconies with ocean or jungle views.
facts.excerpt: private balconies with ocean or jungle views

facts.text: Bathrooms are open-concept with deep soaking baths and glass-enclosed showers.
facts.excerpt: open-concept bathrooms, home to deep soaking baths and glass-enclosed showers

facts.text: The W Suite's rooftop has panoramic views of the resort and ocean, a plunge pool, a fire pit and lounge chairs.
facts.excerpt: the rooftop at your W Suite, which offers panoramic views of the resort and the ocean and features a plunge pool, a fire pit, and comfortable lounge chairs.

facts.text: Ground-floor beachfront suites, steps from the sand, have a private pool.
facts.excerpt: Located just steps away from the sand, they boast a private pool

facts.text: The Oasis Villa Presidential Suite has two bedrooms, an oceanview living room, an outdoor jacuzzi and a rooftop with 360-degree views.
facts.excerpt: With two bedrooms, an ample oceanview living room, and an outdoor jacuzzi, it features everything you need for an incomparable getaway. 360-degree views at the rooftop

facts.text: Mesa 1 is a private outdoor seven-course dinner on an island in the center of a spring-fed lake.
facts.excerpt: Steal the scene with a seven-course dinner at Mesa 1, our private outdoor dining experience in Punta de Mita, Mexico, on an island in the center of a spring-fed lake.

facts.text: Rubra, led by chef Daniela Soto-Innes, uses ingredients harvested from the hotel's own garden.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in the vision of renowned chef Daniela Soto-Innes and experience a culinary concept that honors nature’s cycles with ingredients harvested from our own garden.

facts.text: AWAY Spa has a jungle setting with customized spa therapies and beauty treatments.
facts.excerpt: AWAY® Spa, our Punta de Mita spa, where a tranquil jungle setting, holistic amenities, customized spa therapies, and beauty treatments

facts.text: The Agave Lab is a guided tequila, mezcal and raicilla tasting.
facts.excerpt: Agave Lab: Guided Tequila, Mezcal and Raicilla tasting

facts.text: The Marietas Islands, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, are nearby.
facts.excerpt: explore the nearby Marietas Islands, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler calls the hotel more stylish and party-oriented than most of its counterparts in Punta Mita.
facts.excerpt: More stylish and party-oriented than most of its counterparts in Punta Mita

facts.text: Puerto Vallarta, home to the airport, is less than an hour away.
facts.excerpt: Puerto Vallarta (home to the airport and less than an hour away)
